Definition: Whether legal or regulatory requirements obligate payment service providers to notify users, regulators, and/or data protection authorities about payment data breaches, cybersecurity incidents, or unauthorized access within specified timeframes.
Comments: No primary legal text found confirming mandatory data breach notification obligations in Mali; secondary legal summaries mention breach notification concepts, but without an authoritative government/APDP legal source accessible in this research set.

revision_notes: Initial light check surfaced two conflicting secondary sources (one legal tracker stating breach notification to the APDP is 'envisaged but not on a fixed timeline'; a content-mill article claiming a mandatory 72-hour notification under an unverified 'Decree No. 2018-043'), so the row was escalated from the fast path to a full check. Read the primary text of Law No. 2013-015 of 21 May 2013 on the Protection of Personal Data (via primature.ml) in full detail on articles covering APDP powers, sanctions, and data-subject rights; it does not contain an explicit breach-notification obligation comparable to GDPR Art.33/34, and no BCEAO/payment-sector-specific breach notification instruction was located. Given the conflicting and unverified secondary claims and the absence of a clear primary provision, the value code is kept at 0/Unknown rather than asserted as Discretionary or Mandatory. Flagged for human review because of the conflicting secondary sources found.
revised_comments: Mali's Law No. 2013-015 of 21 May 2013 on the Protection of Personal Data establishes the Autorité de Protection des Données à Caractère Personnel (APDP) as the data protection regulator, but does not set out an explicit, timebound data-breach notification obligation for payment service providers. Secondary legal commentary is inconsistent on whether any implied notification duty carries a fixed timeframe, and no dedicated payment-sector (e.g. BCEAO) regulation specifically mandating breach notification has been identified. The existence and scope of any mandatory breach-notification requirement for payment data in Mali therefore remains unclear.
